metadata.case_name: LEUNG SO AND ANOTHER v. CANOSSA HOSPITAL

injuries.description: introchanteric fracture of the right femur
source: The break in her right thigh was in her case an introchanteric fracture of the right femur.

injuries.description: cerebral thrombosis giving rise to rightside hemiplegia and aphasia (loss of speech)
source: The stroke she suffered in December 1980 and the effects of it are that she suffered a cerebral thrombosis giving rise to rightside hemiplegia and aphasia (loss of speech) and her present loss of intellectual powers is diagnosed as the result of extensive brain atrophy.
her present loss of intellectual powers is diagnosed as the result of extensive brain atrophy.

By way of further additions to these now permanent afflictions, she was diagnosed in August 1979 as suffering from mild diabetes, medically known as diabetes mellitus, and, at least by January 1981, if not earlier, she suffered from a heart problem referred to by her family doctor as Ischemic Heart Disease.

injuries.description: healed wound relating to a 1977 fracture of the upper right arm bone, the humerus
source: Dating back from 1977 she had a healed wound relating to the fact that in that year she broke the upper right arm bone, the humerus.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of shoulder or upper arm, unspecified

injuries.description: attack of cystitis (inflammation of the urinary tract)
source: It is admitted that an attack of cystitis, an inflammation of the urinary tract, did occur.
Not only are the right upper extremities now wasted, but the left upper extremities have also suffered contractures.

injuries.description: contractures of the left upper extremities
source: Not only are the right upper extremities now wasted, but the left upper extremities have also suffered contractures.

injuries.description: both lower extremities held in flexion at the hip and knee
source: Both lower extremities are held in flexion at the hip and knee.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the knee or lower leg

source: Further contractures were noticed towards the end of 1981 at which time she also became incontinent of bowel and urine.
In early May 1985 she developed what was described as a low-grade fever, which was slow to disappear.

injuries.description: shortening of the right leg by 11/2 centimetres
source: The shortening was, according to him, 11/2 centimetres, and in no way an impediment either to walking or to physiotherapy.

completely lost her intellectual powers, being totally uncommunicable and completely out of touch with her surroundings

treatments_received: post-operative nursing and medications (e.g. librium, Largactil as recorded)

losses.description: General damages for pain, suffering and loss of amenities in respect of the fractured femur (assessed at $40,000 if liability had been found).
